annotations.title: See which AI bots a website lets in

description: Use when the user asks whether their site (or any public site) blocks ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Perplexity or other AI crawlers, whether AI can read or train on their content, or why AI search does not mention their site. Fetches the live robots.txt and reports, for 22 named AI bots in four groups (AI training, AI search, assistants, search engines), which are let in, kept out or partly blocked, plus the site's content-signal preference and fixes. Example: {"url": "example.com"}. Read-only. To write a new robots.txt use doorman_write_robots_txt.

url.description: Website address or domain, e.g. nytimes.com
